action.cancelConfirmBody: The clone is stopped. The destination folder may be left partial and is never deleted.
action.removeConfirmBody: The clone record is removed from the queue. Files on disk are never deleted.
action.retryBody: A retry clones into an empty folder. The original destination is allowed only when that folder is missing or empty. Resume in place is not supported and existing files are never overwritten or deleted.
